label: Startup RPM offset
explicit_non_effects: does not add startup airflow directly

label: Startup RPM decay time
intended_effect: sets decay of startup RPM offset

label: Startup air decay time
explicit_non_effects: does not change afterstart fuel decay

label: Follower seed
intended_effect: sets dashpot airflow seeded on throttle close
explicit_non_effects: does not alter base IAC position

label: Stall-save gain
intended_effect: sets additional IAC response to stall deficit
explicit_non_effects: does not alter normal PI gain

label: Stall-save maximum
explicit_non_effects: does not set IAC maximum position

label: Idle TPS entry
intended_effect: sets throttle threshold for idle entry

label: Idle TPS exit
explicit_non_effects: does not set DFCO TPS threshold

label: Idle entry RPM ceiling
intended_effect: sets maximum RPM allowed for idle entry
explicit_non_effects: does not set target idle RPM

label: Idle entry delay
intended_effect: sets time idle conditions must persist before control activates
